workshops.title: .NET on AWS workshop
workshops.description: Hands-on labs introducing tools and services to develop, build, and deploy .NET applications on AWS. Deploy ASP.NET Core apps to Elastic Beanstalk, ECS Fargate, Lambda & App Runner. Integrate DynamoDB, secure secrets with Secrets Manager & Parameter Store, instrument with X-Ray, authenticate with Cognito, build CI/CD pipelines, and define infrastructure with AWS CDK using C#.

workshops.title: [WEB201] Improve Your Architecture with Amazon CloudFront
workshops.description: Amazon CloudFront is a fast, secure, developer-friendly content delivery network (CDN). In this workshop, you'll start with a provided web application and build a CloudFront distribution to front it. Through a series of hands-on challenges, you'll learn how to improve the security, performance, and reliability of your architecture using CloudFront.

workshops.title: Accelerating .NET and SQL Server Modernization using Agentic AI
workshops.description: Accelerate the deployment and operation of your .NET applications and SQL Server workloads with agentic AI-powered experience on AWS. Through hands-on examples, learn how to streamline complex workflows into intuitive, guided steps, reduce manual effort, and improve reliability. See how AWS agentic AI helps you build, deploy, and operate production-ready .NET applications with SQL Server backends efficiently — unlocking better scalability, resilience, and developer productivity.

workshops.title: Active Directory on AWS workshop
workshops.description: A guide to deploying Active Directory (AD) on AWS, set up hybrid solutions, and set up Hybrid DNS. Security and compliance best practices for AD on AWS are also covered.

workshops.title: Add Real-Time Web Search to Your AI Agents on AWS
workshops.description: Learn how to add real-time web search capabilities to AI agents and applications on AWS. Explore two paths: a managed MCP connector via AgentCore Gateway (works with any model) and the Bedrock built-in web search tool. Build agents using Strands SDK, LangChain, or raw tool-calling, and integrate with developer tools like Claude Code and Codex.

workshops.title: Advanced Development with Kiro CLI
workshops.description: This workshop is a follow-on training session to the introductory Q-Words session that dives into more advanced topics around context management, profile management, and model context protocol (MCP) servers. Participants should have a good understanding of Kiro CLI / Q Developer and have the CLI and IDE installed. They will walk away from this training with a better understanding how to use Kiro CLI on larger enterprise grade applications both greenfield and brownfield.

workshops.title: Advanced model customization on Amazon SageMaker AI
workshops.description: This workshop provides hands-on experience customizing SLMs and LLMs on Amazon SageMaker AI. Attendees will learn to prepare datasets, run distributed training with LoRA and QLoRA across Continued Pre-Training, SFT, and DPO, deploy fine-tuned models, and evaluate them using statistical metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge — using both SageMaker Training Jobs and SageMaker HyperPod with EKS.

workshops.title: Agent Toolkit for AWS
workshops.description: Give your coding agent the tools, knowledge, and guardrails to build production-ready infrastructure on AWS.

workshops.title: Agentic AI-Powered anomaly detection: Spotting anomalies in real-time
workshops.description: This hands-on workshop demonstrates how to implement real-time data processing using AWS data streaming services, combining Apache Kafka (MSK), Apache Flink (MSF), and Amazon Bedrock for Agentic AI integration.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)

workshops.title: Agentic Fraud Detection
workshops.description: Build the offline optimization layer for payment fraud detection. Ingest 24M transactions into Apache Iceberg, construct a Neptune knowledge graph revealing fraud rings, and train a unified XGBoost ensemble combining transaction foundation model embeddings, GNN graph embeddings, and traditional features. Deploy AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that autonomously investigate patterns, score customers with explainable predictions, and generate detection rules — compressing weeks into minutes.

workshops.title: Agentic model customization using Amazon SageMakerAI with agent skills and Kiro
workshops.description: Amazon SageMaker AI agent-guided model customization transforms the way developers fine-tune foundation models. Using purpose-built Agent Skills with Kiro or ClaudeCode directly within SageMaker AI Studio JupyterLab, you'll customize LLMs through agentic chat — no deep ML expertise required. The agent guides you through the complete customization lifecycle: from use case definition and data preparation through technique selection, serverless training, LLM-as-Judge evaluation, and deployment.

workshops.title: Agentic SaaSops
workshops.description: We’ll explore how and where agents can be introduced into your multi-tenant operational experience, enabling architects to better analyze, measure, and refine the footprint, and policies of their SaaS environments.

workshops.title: Agentic SecOps with Cybersecurity Agent Factory and Amazon Bedrock
workshops.description: This workshop is intended to help candidates mitigate Security risks at scale with agentic security workflows and custom autonomous agents. this workflow contains agentic Incident response integrated with Amazon GuardDuty, IAM operations automation, Agentic Vulnerability management remediation workflow integrated with Amazon inspector, and Automated Posture violation remediation integration with aws security hub.

workshops.title: Agentic Transformation Workshop
workshops.description: Go from "where should we use agents?" to a deployed agentic use case using AWS Transform end-to-end. Discover business processes with EventStorming, identify where agents add value with Cognitive Complexity Analysis, run Agentic Readiness and Modernization analyses, build a prioritized roadmap, and execute an automated transformation — all with first-party AWS tooling including the atx CLI and Kiro CLI.

workshops.title: AI for ECS Ops
workshops.description: Accelerate your cloud development journey with this hands-on builder session demonstrating how to leverage Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Kiro CLI, and AI assistance on AWS. Participate live as we showcase how AI can dramatically speed up your PoC development, MVP creation, production infrastructure deployment, and migration of existing workloads using Amazon ECS.

workshops.title: AI-DLC Workshop
workshops.description: Learn AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), a human-centric methodology where AI drives the workflow and you make the decisions. Using Kiro CLI, go hands-on from inception to operations: guide AI planning sessions, apply Domain-Driven Design, and build a complete application end-to-end. Trade weeks-long cycles for hours. Built for developers, product owners, and technical leaders ready to put human-AI collaboration to work.

workshops.description: Amazon DocumentDB workshop is a on demand set of hands-on labs categorized as independent self-service modules.You can select either one or a set of modules, as needed and complete them at your own pace
