workshops.description: The Amazon DynamoDB workshop provides hands-on training for developers. It covers basic table operations and advanced NoSQL data modeling like single-table design. You will learn to manage relationships using primary keys and secondary indexes. The workshop shows how to build multi-region apps with Global Tables and use event-driven patterns with DynamoDB Streams and Lambda. It includes labs for high-scale gaming data and focuses on performance and cost optimization.

workshops.title: Amazon ECS Workshop
workshops.description: An ECS Workshop provides an end-to-end application development and deployment experience to demonstrate features of Amazon ECS, using real-world services from an application development perspective in order to educate users about the features of Amazon ECS such as scaling, networking, observability, security and automation.

workshops.title: Amazon EKS Auto Mode Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop guides you through the features of EKS Auto Mode and how it simplifies application deployment into your Amazon EKS clusters. Participants will learn to enable EKS Auto Mode and deploy applications that use it's different capabilities. The workshop covers compute optimization, autoscaling, networking, storage, cluster upgrades, and workload migration. Upon completion participants will be able to effectively launch and manage Kubernetes applications on AWS using EKS Auto Mode.

workshops.title: Amazon EKS Security Workshop
workshops.description: Hands-on workshop covering Amazon EKS security best practices. Lab modules include: Identity and Access Management (IRSA, Pod Identity, Access Entries), Pod Security Standards, Network Policies, Amazon GuardDuty for EKS, CloudTrail log analysis, VPC Lattice, mTLS with ALB, Fully Private Clusters, Bottlerocket security, CIS Benchmark compliance, Amazon ECR controls, Amazon Inspector CVE management, DevSecOps pipelines, container image signing with AWS

workshops.title: Amazon EKS Workshop
workshops.description: This is the Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service workshop as hosted on eksworkshop.com. This workshop covers a breadth of content related to EKS and some related technologies and is designed to cater for customers of a variety of skill and experience levels.

workshops.title: Amazon EMR Cost Optimization Workshop
workshops.description: Customers often have this question on performance and cost optimization when they plan to migrate or are migrating their big data workloads to AWS such as 1/ if they are using Amazon EMR optimally to reduce costs?, 2/ How could they further reduce costs for their workloads? Join this workshop to implement cost optimizing best practices on Amazon EMR.

workshops.title: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink workshop
workshops.description: The Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink workshop includes various modules that will cover everything from the basics of Flink to its implementation on Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink. This will provide a comprehensive and consolidated content that will help our customers fully understand and utilize the benefits of Flink on AWS. It will be a workshop style, immersive and hands-on experience that will empower our customers to implement Flink with confidence and ease.

workshops.title: Amazon MQ Workshop For RabbitMQ
workshops.description: An introduction to Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ concepts and deep dive into deployment model, failover and cloudwatch monitoring of RabbitMQ broker.

workshops.title: Amazon MSK Connect
workshops.description: Amazon MSK Connect lab is a Lab designed to gain hands-on experience with running popular open-source connectors on a serverless infrastructure, created and managed by Amazon MSK Connect. Learn how to replicate data for synchronization use-cases and more through data streams managed by Amazon MSK.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)

workshops.title: Amazon MSK Migration
workshops.description: This hands-on workshop guides you through configuring replication pipelines between self-managed, or third-party-managed Apache Kafka clusters and Amazon MSK. Learn to set up cross-region, cross-account, and cross-VPC replication for migration, hybrid architectures, or disaster recovery scenarios. Ideal for architects and engineers building resilient streaming data pipelines with basic Kafka knowledge and AWS networking familiarity.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)

workshops.title: Amazon MSK Replicator
workshops.description: Amazon MSK Replicator is a feature of Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) that enables customers to reliably replicate data across Amazon MSK clusters in same or different AWS regions, without writing code or managing infrastructure. Note: To support MSK Replicator for cross-region replication (CRR), select 2 different regions under Accessible regions while creating a event for this Amazon MSK Replicator workshop.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)

workshops.title: Amazon MWAA for Analytics Workshop
workshops.description: [Current] In this workshop, you will learn to build and orchestrate data and ML pipelines that include many of the AWS Analytics and ML services, and with that you will gain familiarity and a better understanding of the hooks and operators available as part of Airflow to manage your pipelines/workflows on AWS. [Work in progress] Airflow 3 MWAA Workshop
services: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow

workshops.title: Amazon Quick for Automotive & Manufacturing: From Data to Decisions
workshops.description: Welcome! This hands-on workshop guides you through the key features of the Amazon Quick using a practical automotive and manufacturing scenario — from Chat and Spaces to Flows and QuickSight analytics, run end-to-end.

workshops.title: Amazon Quick for Energy & Utilities
workshops.description: Step into the role of a Energy Operations Director and learn Amazon Quick hands-on. Through progressive modules, you'll use AI-powered chat, Spaces, autonomous research, workflow automation, custom agents, and analytics to solve real renewable energy operations challenges, from wind turbine maintenance to solar performance and regulatory compliance. No ML expertise required. Available as an AWS event or self-paced.

workshops.title: Amazon Quick for Research
workshops.description: Amazon Quick workshop targeting research use-cases covering all the core capabilities.

workshops.title: Amazon RDS for Db2 Workshop
workshops.description: A deeper dive into the Amazon RDS for Db2 service, exploring its key features, high availability, disaster recovery, automated backups, security, and monitoring capabilities. This session also covers a practical, step-by-step migration approach for Db2 workloads to AWS.

workshops.title: Amazon RDS for MySQL Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop covers the essential concepts required to effectively set up and manage databases on Amazon RDS for MySQL. Key sessions include high availability and disaster recovery (HA/DR), RDS Proxy, and a deep dive into configuring an active-active cluster using MySQL Group Replication. It also explores the Amazon Athena Federated Query feature, enabling you to run SQL queries across data stored in RDS for MySQL as well as data lakes hosted on Amazon S3.

workshops.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle Workshop
workshops.description: A deeper dive into the Amazon RDS for Oracle service, features and migration approach

workshops.title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Workshop
workshops.description: The RDS PostgreSQL workshop provides customers with hands-on experience using Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. It uses a modular content format including foundational, intermediate, and advanced labs covering a wide range of RDS features and PostgreSQL topics.

workshops.title: Amazon RDS for SQL Server Workshop
workshops.description: The Amazon RDS for SQL Server Workshop is a hands-on lab experience for database administrators, developers, and cloud architects. Participants learn to provision and manage SQL Server on Amazon RDS, covering instance creation, high availability with Multi-AZ, backup and restore, security, compute and storage scaling, performance monitoring, and database upgrades. By the end, you'll have practical skills to confidently operate managed SQL Server databases in the cloud.

workshops.title: Amazon Redshift Hands-on Workshop
workshops.description: This set of workshops provides a series of exercises which help users get started using the Redshift platform. It also helps demonstrate the many features built into the platform.

workshops.title: Amazon S3 Workshop
workshops.description: Explore Amazon S3 best practices through hands-on labs covering security, data protection, performance optimization, serverless architectures, cost management, data migration, and storage features including S3 Glacier, S3 Tables, and Storage Lens.

workshops.title: Amazon SageMaker AI MLOps - from idea to production
workshops.description: This workshop takes you through the process of development a machine learning (ML) solution. You create a ML project in Amazon SageMaker Studio and go through all stages of implementation such as data exploration, interactive experimentation, using SageMaker jobs, setting up MLOps pipelines, and finally deliver the project into production. You learn how to work with SageMaker MLOps building blocks. The target audience are data scientists, ML, MLOps, and DevOps engineers, and technical managers.

workshops.title: Amazon SageMaker AI Workshop
workshops.description: Hands-on workshop covering the end-to-end ML lifecycle with Amazon SageMaker AI — from data preparation and model training to deployment, MLOps, and governance across nine guided labs.

workshops.title: Amplify Workshop
workshops.description: The Amplify Gen 2 Workshop provides developers with a hands-on experience in the code-first Amplify developer ecosystem. Participants will deploy a serverless backend using AppSync, DynamoDB, and Cognito along with a React client frontend via a CI/CD pipeline built in Amplify. Participants will learn to build with new AWS Amplify CDK constructs, scripts, Amplify Hosting, and libraries. Participants also explore related app dev topics such as authentication, data modelling, and UI development.

workshops.title: Analytics on EKS
workshops.description: This advanced workshop teaches you how to optimize Amazon EKS Auto Mode for cost-performance when running Apache Spark analytics jobs. You'll run the same Spark job five times with different infrastructure configurations including Spot instances, NVMe storage, and Graviton, and compare completion times. You'll then monitor and analyze cost per job. By the end, you'll be able to compare infrastructure options and make informed cost-performance decisions for Spark workloads on EKS.

workshops.title: ANT402 - Build an end-to-end fraud detection solution with Amazon SageMaker
workshops.description: Experience the seamless integration of Amazon EMR, Amazon Athena and AWS Glue with Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio to create a sophisticated fraud detection system. Learn how to leverage serverless compute for complex financial workloads while ensuring operational efficiency and security. Specifically designed for financial service organizations, join this session to build an end-to-end fraud analytics data pipeline with Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio.

workshops.title: Approaches to layered security on Amazon VPC
workshops.description: In this workshop, discover practical guidance that can help you build a secure Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC). Using a hands-on approach, review Amazon VPC features such as subnets, security groups, flow logs, and routing. Then, learn how you can add on additional layers of security and how to securely ingress and egress VPC traffic with other services, such as Amazon Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall, AWS Network Firewall, Gateway Load Balancer, Traffic Mirroring, AWS WAF, and more.

workshops.title: Appsync Workshop
workshops.description: The AWS AppSync workshop provides an introduction to implementing serverless GraphQl APIs connected to multiple data sources with AppSync (a managed GraphQl service on AWS)

workshops.title: Architecting GenAI Solutions for Intelligent Video Analysis
workshops.description: This hands-on workshop teaches you how to evaluate and select optimal GenAI models for video analysis across different use cases. You'll explore a comprehensive framework comparing image understanding, video understanding, and video embedding models while learning to match solutions to specific requirements—from media, entertainment, gaming and sports content to enterprise training videos and advertising campaigns, from social media user-generated content to security camera surveillance systems.

workshops.title: Aurora DSQL Workshop
workshops.description: Amazon Aurora DSQL is a serverless distributed SQL database with virtually unlimited scale, the highest availability, and zero infrastructure management. In this workshop, we will dive deep into how DSQL works, how it is different from traditional relational databases, and how you can leverage its design and features to help grow your application.

workshops.title: Aurora MySQL Deep Dive Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop covers all essential concepts required to appropriately set up your databases on Aurora MySQL. Some of the important sessions include testing Aurora Failovers, RDS Proxy, Deep dive into Aurora monitoring and setting up disaster recovery with Aurora Global Databases. This workshop was previously named Aurora MySQL Immersion Day.

workshops.title: Automate Java Application Upgrades with Generative AI
workshops.description: Automate Java Application Upgrades with Generative AI - AWS Transform custom

workshops.title: Automating Lambda Runtime Upgrades with AWS Transform custom
workshops.description: Learn how to use AWS Transform custom to automate Lambda runtime upgrades from Python 3.8 to Python 3.13, including code changes, dependency updates, and infrastructure-as-code modifications.

workshops.title: AWS 101 - NoSQL Databases
workshops.description: This entry-level workshop is designed for individuals who are new to Amazon Web Services and want to gain practical experience in setting up and storing data in our variety of NoSQL database services.

workshops.title: AWS Analytics Experience for FSI Insurance with SageMaker Next Gen
workshops.description: Experience how the next generation of SageMaker and AWS analytics services come together to drive data insights across your insurance organization. In this workshop, you choose from 4 personas and follow their data journey though discovery, preparation, insights, and communication. This workshop opens with SageMaker Unified Studio deployed alongside InsuranceLake. Workshop users will use the AWS Console to start the experience and complete the journey in SageMaker Unified Studio and Quick Suite.

workshops.title: AWS Cloud WAN Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop provides setup instruction and several labs for AWS Cloud WAN workshop.

workshops.title: AWS CloudFormation Workshop
workshops.description: AWS CloudFormation Workshop covering levels 100 through 400. Learn to create, manage, and deploy infrastructure as code on AWS using CloudFormation templates, stacks, changesets, and best practices for real-world cloud environments.

workshops.title: AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) Query Library
workshops.description: The AWS CUR Query Library (CQL) is a collection of curated SQL queries to get you started with analyzing your Cost and Usage Report (CUR) data. Cost analysis is unique to each business and these queries are intended to be modified to suit your specific needs. The library will be updated periodically as we build new queries and receive feedback from customers.

workshops.title: AWS Device Farm Workshop
workshops.description: A workshop to help customers get started with AWS Device Farm and learn how to test applications

workshops.title: AWS Direct Connect & Hybrid DNS Workshop
workshops.description: In this workshop, participants implement and configure AWS Direct Connect with DXGW/TGW, and connect an on-premises data center to AWS. They also implement hybrid DNS using Amazon Route 53 Resolver Endpoints. The target audience for this workshop is networking and infrastructure teams. This workshop expects a basic level of networking knowledge.

workshops.title: AWS Direct Connect Resiliency Workshop
workshops.description: In this workshop, you will gain hands-on experience ordering connections, configuring AWS networking and on-premises routers, and establishing resilient connectivity using AWS Direct Connect, Direct Connect Gateway, and AWS Transit Gateway.

workshops.title: AWS DMS workshop for customers (AWS Database Migration service workshop)
workshops.description: In this workshop, we will explore how you can migrate your data to and from the most widely used commercial (Oracle/SQL Server) and open-source databases (MySQL/Postgres) as well as non-database sources & targets like Amazon S3 using the AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) and AWS Schema Conversion(SC) with GenAI or classic SCT download tool. In 2025, we added java application embedded SQL conversion with Amazon Q. There is also advanced schema conversion for Oracle/SQL Server to PostgreSQL.

workshops.title: AWS Gateway Load Balancer Workshop
workshops.description: Learn how to use the AWS's Gateway Load Balancer with other third-party firewalls and with open source software. This workshop goes overbuilding your own firewall in the cloud, and shows you the steps to accomplish it along the way.

workshops.title: AWS Glue Workshop
workshops.description: Learn AWS Glue through hands-on labs covering data cataloging, ETL development with Glue Studio, job bookmarks, orchestration with Step Functions and EventBridge, monitoring, data quality, and DataBrew. Designed for data engineers and analysts.

workshops.title: AWS HealthOmics: Modernizing Genomics from Storage to GenAI
workshops.description: Learn to modernize genomics workloads using AWS HealthOmics. This hands-on workshop covers genomic data storage with Reference and Sequence Stores, running WDL/Nextflow workflows, migrating nf-core pipelines, querying variant data with S3 Tables and Athena, and leveraging Kiro CLI for AI-assisted workflow development. Build production-ready genomics pipelines from storage to analysis.

workshops.title: AWS Hybrid Cloud General Workshop
workshops.description: Hybrid Cloud General Workshop, this lab demonstrates how to extend Amazon EKS clusters across the continuum of AWS Hybrid & Edge services, demonstrating the consistent experience across security, management and connectivity.

workshops.title: AWS Instant Payments with Finzly
workshops.description: This workshop will provide hands-on experience to use Payment Galaxy (Finzly’s payment hub) on AWS to connect to FedNow and RTP networks to provide instant payment services between bank accounts.

workshops.title: AWS IoT Core - Learning Path - Basic
workshops.description: Learn AWS IoT Core fundamentals through hands-on exercises. You'll gain essential knowledge in secure IoT architectures with X.509 certificates, implement real-time communication via MQTT and WebSocket protocols, understand device state management with IoT Device Shadow, and master message processing with IoT Rules Engine. Build practical skills to design and implement IoT solutions using AWS IoT Core.

workshops.title: AWS IoT Device Management - Learning Path - Basic
workshops.description: This hands-on workshop introduces AWS IoT Device Management for organizing, monitoring, and managing IoT device fleets at scale. Through practical exercises, you’ll work with AWS IoT Fleet Indexing, dynamic Thing Groups, firmware management via AWS IoT Software Package Catalog, OTA updates with AWS IoT Jobs, real-time control using AWS IoT Commands, bulk device registration, and monitoring and troubleshooting with Amazon CloudWatch.

workshops.title: AWS IoT Greengrass V2 - Workshop
workshops.description: AWS IoT Greengrass v2 is an Internet of Things (IoT) open source edge runtime and cloud service that helps you build, deploy, and manage device software. You can learn basic knowledge to use AWS IoT Greengrass V2 through this workshop.

workshops.title: AWS Local Zones Workshop - Amazon EKS
workshops.description: This AWS Local Zones Workshop provides customers with hands-on experience, this workshop allowing attendees to get familiar with Amazon EKS data plane and how it can be extended to be deployed in AWS Local Zones. This workshop covers the essential steps to extend an Amazon EKS cluster to Local Zones, this includes setting up Amazon EKS cluster, launching self-managed node in the Local Zone, joining the node in the Local Zone to the EKS cluster.

workshops.title: AWS Local Zones Workshop: Run low-latency applications at the edge
workshops.description: Welcome to AWS Local Zones Workshop! This hands-on AWS Local Zones Workshop is designed to give customers and partners practical experience with AWS Local Zones. In this workshop, join AWS experts in deploying an object detector application closer to your on premises location.

workshops.title: AWS Managed Services (AMS) - Self paced labs
workshops.description: AWS Managed Services - Immersion trainings and labs

workshops.title: AWS Marketplace Seller Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop guides sellers through onboarding to AWS Marketplace, listing and integrating each product type, and working with the Marketplace APIs. It also includes end-to-end listing labs for common seller use cases.

workshops.title: AWS MediaTailor Foundations Workshop: Deploying and Customizing the Live Event Framework
workshops.description: In this hands-on workshop, you'll learn how to use the Live Event Framework (LEF) to rapidly deploy and configure live streaming infrastructure on AWS, prepared for monetization using AWS Elemental MediaTailor. We will explore best practices and steps for customizing the framework to meet specific requirements.

workshops.title: AWS Networking Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop covers the full spectrum of AWS Networking, from the basics of VPC and Subnets to the advanced configurations with Transit Gateway and VPN, including security and monitoring examples

workshops.title: AWS Parallel Computing Service Workshop
workshops.description: AWS Parallel Computing Service (AWS PCS) is a managed service that makes it easier to run and scale high performance computing (HPC) workloads, and build scientific and engineering models on AWS using Slurm. Use AWS PCS to build compute clusters that integrate best in class AWS compute, storage, networking, and visualization. Run simulations or build scientific and engineering models. Streamline and simplify your cluster operations using built-in management and observability capabilities.

workshops.title: AWS Partner CRM Integration (Consolidated)
workshops.description: These workshops helps AWS Partners on APN to automate their co-sell operation by integrating their Customer Relationship Management environment with AWS Partner central and AWS marketplace services.

workshops.title: AWS Payments Security
workshops.description: This workshop familiarizes attendees with AWS Payment Cryptography service and demonstrates how to use the service for common FSI use cases related payments acceptance.

workshops.title: AWS Serverless Developer Experience
workshops.description: This workshop is a hands-on training program to develop serverless skills using AWS SAM and SAM CLI. It focuses on practical, code-centric learning with real-world scenarios, covering distributed event-driven architectures, messaging patterns, orchestration, and observability. Participants will use open-source tools, Powertools for AWS, and CI/CD. Available in Python, TypeScript, Java, or .NET.

workshops.title: AWS Storage Workshop
workshops.description: An AWS Storage focused workshop, that introduces several AWS storage services with a focus on storage security best practices, data migration strategies, storage performance tuning, and backup.

workshops.title: AWS Transform custom - Automate your code transformations and retire tech debt at scale
workshops.description: This hands-on workshop will enable you to automate a wide range of code maintenance and evolution tasks using AWS Transform custom. Attendees will learn real-world use cases demonstrating significant time and cost savings compared to manual approaches. Whether you're looking to streamline API upgrades, migrate frameworks, or enforce coding standards, this workshop will provide a glimpse into the future of scalable, automated code transformations.

workshops.title: AWS Transform for Assessments
workshops.description: In this workshop you will learn how to use AWS Transform for Assessments, go through a few scenarios to guestimate a scope of servers and then assess dependencies of the pre-defined discovered inventory file

workshops.title: AWS Transform for SQL Server
workshops.description: AWS Transform for SQL Server Modernization - Offline Source migrating SQL Server to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL

workshops.title: AWS Transform for VMware Migrations
workshops.description: In this workshop, you will gain hands-on experience with AWS Transform capabilities to perform Assessment and Discovery of your on-premises environment and create a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis to build a compelling business case for cloud adoption. You will also learn how to quickly migrate applications running on VMware environments to AWS — leveraging the power of Agentic AI tools, note this workshop does not support self-paced, only AWS-lead events by using Workshop Studio.

workshops.title: Build an agentic AI system on Amazon EKS with CPU-only inference
workshops.description: Build a multi-agent AI system on Amazon EKS Auto Mode that serves every model on CPU: a fine-tuned intent router and embedding model (ONNX, trained on CPU), a cross-encoder re-ranker, and a quantized generative analyst on llama.cpp grounded by RAG from OpenSearch. Amazon Bedrock generates synthetic training data, judges answers with a faithfulness gate, and handles edge cases small models cannot. A control test puts a frontier LLM in the same seat so you know if the small model is good enough.

workshops.title: Build with Amazon OpenSearch Service (Official Workshop)
workshops.description: Hands-on workshop exploring Amazon OpenSearch Service through independent lab modules. Build full-text search queries, use observability tools to troubleshoot a microservices application, and construct AI-powered search experiences using semantic, hybrid, and conversational search with Amazon Bedrock. Each module is self-contained — pick the topics most relevant to you.

workshops.title: Build Your First Graph Application with Amazon Neptune
workshops.description: Learn everything you need to know to get started with graph databases on Amazon Neptune. This includes how to set up, configure, and manage a Neptune Database cluster according to operational best practices, how to write graph queries, and how to integrate Neptune Database into a full end-to-end solution with a user interface.

workshops.title: Build, Test, Optimize: Hands-On with Amazon Connect Customer agentic CX designer (ACXD)
workshops.description: In this hands-on workshop, you build, test, and optimize an agentic self-service experience in Amazon Connect Customer using the agentic CX designer (ACXD). You start in a prebuilt Amazon Connect environment, pick one of ten industry scenarios, and take a conversational agent from its first prompt to a tested, deployed experience on chat and voice. No coding is required.

workshops.title: Building AI Agents with Strands SDK: From Simple Loops to Multi-Agent Swarms
workshops.description: Build a production-ready customer service AI agent step by step with the open-source Strands Agents SDK, then take it to production on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Seven hands-on modules, one new capability each.

workshops.title: Building an Agentic AI Platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
workshops.description: This hands-on workshop teaches customers and partners how to establish solid foundations for building and operating Agentic AI applications on AWS at scale. Participants will learn a 3-module framework covering platform infrastructure setup, agent development with reusable patterns, and production deployment lifecycle management. The workshop uses AgentCore and follows AWS Well-Architected best practices for security, governance, and operational excellence.

workshops.title: Building an AI-powered Underwriting Assistant to Enable Faster Decision Making
workshops.description: In this hands-on workshop, participants will learn to build an AI-powered document processing solution that transforms insurance underwriting workflows using Amazon Bedrock. You'll explore how to leverage Bedrock Data Automation and Claude's multimodal capabilities to automatically extract, organize, and analyze information from complex insurance documents across Life and P&C lines.

workshops.title: Building and scaling Agentic AI workflows
workshops.description: This workshop provides a hands-on experience for implementing agentic AI patterns using Amazon Bedrock, Step Functions, and Lambda. Learn about different ways to implement agentic AI, compare and contrast the approaches and choose the one for your use case

workshops.title: Building and Scaling Intelligent Document Processing workflows
workshops.description: This workshop provides you a hands-on experience building Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) workflows using AWS Step Functions, AWS Lambda, and Amazon Bedrock. Learn to scale the solution from 1 to 1M documents.

workshops.title: Building embedded Linux devices with AWS IoT Greengrass nucleus lite
workshops.description: AWS IoT Greengrass nucleus lite is an edge runtime that helps you build cloud-connected resource-constrained embedded Linux devices. In this workshop, you'll learn how to bake your embedded Linux distribution, flash and provision your devices at scale, perform OS image updates using A/B partitions, manage your device fleet and application updates, efficiently iterate and debug, and use Kiro CLI to accelerate your development process.

workshops.title: Building event-driven architectures on AWS
workshops.description: In this workshop we’ll cover the basics of event-driven design, using examples that involve Amazon EventBridge, Amazon SNS, Amazon SQS, AWS Lambda and more. You will learn how to choose the right AWS service for the job, as well as how to optimize for both cost and performance. Through hands on practice, this workshop will give you the skills bring event-driven design patterns into your own applications.

workshops.title: Building Modern Resilient Applications using Amazon EKS and Amazon EFS
workshops.description: A highly available application deployed in a multi-AZ active active deployment that has a DR region with hot standby resources where if there is a failure in primary region, you can easily cut-over to secondary region while keeping your application available.

workshops.title: Building secure and responsible generative AI applications with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
workshops.description: In this workshop, we walk through a scenario protecting an application with Amazon Bedrock. We leverage a combination of prompt engineering and Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, to protect against the most common misuse, vulnerabilities, and attack requests. We also incorporate monitoring to gain full insights that can be used for adjustments throughout the application lifecycle.

workshops.title: Building with Amazon Bedrock featuring Claude Code, Kiro, AgentCore, and Strands Agents
workshops.description: Now featuring Strands SDK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Kiro, and Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock! Workshop participants build simple generative AI demo applications while learning key concepts. Labs include agentic fundamentals, security and guardrails, chatbots, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP, agent skills, and Streamlit.

workshops.title: CCoE Workshop
workshops.description: A Workshop to give customers an overview of the topics that should be fully understood before migrating/building production workloads into the AWS cloud, it shouldn’t be considered as the end of the training journey of the CCoE, but it represents the initial milestone of their enablement. It will cover the Core Services that the CCoE should implement before going into production, in particular: Cloud Governance, Cloud Operations and Platform Configuration & Optimization.

workshops.title: CDK Workshop
workshops.description: Workshops to learn the AWS CDK.

workshops.title: Centralized Operations Management on AWS
workshops.description: In this hands-on workshop, you will deep dive into ways in which you can operate your cloud and on-premises environments, including infrastructure and applications. You will go through a hands-on pick your own challenge, to focus on managing and automating infrastructure, application management and governance, and compliance management and assurance.

workshops.title: CFM TIPs Optimization Workshop
workshops.description: This hands-on cost optimization workshop uses CFM TIPs playbooks to teach practical strategies for optimizing AWS infrastructure across EC2, RDS, S3, and EBS. Through interactive exercises and real-world scenarios, participants discover actionable techniques to right-size compute instances, optimize databases, implement intelligent storage tiering, and eliminate unused volumes.

workshops.title: CI/CD on AWS Workshop
workshops.description: CI/CD workshop to offer prescriptive guidance on how to build automation pipelines for * Continuous Integration * Continuous Deployment * Continuous Delivery

workshops.title: Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock
workshops.description: In this hands-on workshop, you will learn how to accelerate team development and scale Claude Code deployments on Amazon Bedrock. You'll discover how to configure team environments, establish standards and workflows, and maximize Claude Code's capabilities to transform coding workflows. The workshop emphasizes best practices from Anthropic and Amazon to help teams get the most out of this powerful AI coding assistant.

workshops.title: Cloud Intelligence Dashboards Discovery & Customizations Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop teaches cost optimization tracking using KPIs and Cloud Intelligence Dashboards. Learn to define unit costs for EC2, EBS, and S3, measure optimization impact across compute and storage, and maximize AWS value while scaling your business

workshops.title: Container Foundations on AWS
workshops.description: Container Foundations on AWS is an entry level hands-on workshop for developers and architects who are new to containers. You will move through the full container lifecycle: building secure, optimized images; managing them in a registry with scanning and signing; supporting multiple CPU architectures including AWS Graviton; and deploying onto AWS. Optional modules cover automated build pipelines.

workshops.title: Data EDU Student Data Lake Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop teaches how to use AWS services to construct a data lake consisting of multiple demo data sets related to students and then to use that data for analytical use cases.

workshops.title: Data Engineering Workshop
workshops.description: Data Engineering Workshop allows hands-on time with AWS big data and analytics services including Amazon Kinesis Services for streaming data ingestion and analytics, AWS Data Migration service for batch data ingestion, AWS Glue for data catalog and run ETL on Data lake, Amazon Athena to query data lake and Amazon Quicksight for visualization. This workshop helps to build a cloud-native and future-proof serverless data lake.

workshops.title: Data for SaaS : Agentic AI Speedrun !!
workshops.description: Data for SaaS : Agentic AI Speedrun !!

workshops.title: Dedicated Host and License Manager Workshop
workshops.description: Learn to manage Microsoft Windows licenses on AWS using License Manager and Dedicated Hosts. Configure licensing rules, deploy EC2 Dedicated Hosts for Windows Server BYOL, automate placements with Host Resource Groups, deploy via CloudFormation, perform license and tenancy conversions, set up discovery rules for SQL Server, and generate audit-ready usage reports. This Level 300 workshop takes 3 hours and targets IT managers, compliance teams, and system administrators

workshops.title: Deploy large Generative AI models with high performance and scale using SageMaker AI
workshops.description: This workshop provides 400 level guidance and best practices in deploying ML and FM models to Amazon SageMaker AI.

workshops.title: Dive Deep into AWS DevOps Agent
workshops.description: Learn how AWS DevOps Agent resolves and proactively prevents incidents, continuously improving reliability/performance of your application. Reduce MTTR, automate root cause analysis, and implement proactive improvements to AWS infrastructure and observability. Features modular format allowing participants to choose relevant modules for their specific needs. To fix transient deployment failures: Login with ops role →CloudFormation →Update workshop-team-stack →Wait 30min →Revalidate deployment.

workshops.title: Dive deep with Apache Iceberg on AWS
workshops.description: Apache Iceberg on AWS - Advanced Workshop

workshops.title: Diving Deep into Bedrock AgentCore (Official Workshop)
workshops.description: A new version of this workshop has been published on Aug 6. Basic knowledge of AgentCore fundamentals is a prerequisite. Please complete the pre-work of pre-testing the workshop and identifying the right subset of samples for your audience. Use the materials in the workshop studio - videos, blogs and reading material to prepare before delivering or attending the workshop. Claude Code is configured with AWS documentation MCP servers as your learning partner.

workshops.title: Documents to Decisions: Agentic Underwriting with Amazon Bedrock
workshops.description: Participants will learn to build an agentic generative AI underwriting workflow on AWS that automates the evaluation of underwriting risk—turning life-insurance submissions into explainable risk assessments and recommended actions using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and the Strands Agents SDK. By the end of this session, you’ll have a working prototype and repo that turns raw submissions into auditable risk assessments, with patterns you can reuse for production.

workshops.title: Efficient and Resilient Workloads with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
workshops.description: This workshop is designed to get you familiar with the concepts and best practices for effectively and efficiently scaling Amazon EC2 capacity using Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling and it’s features including predictive scaling and warm pools. IMPORTANT: Make sure to provision and initiate accounts at least two hours before your event starts. It takes time to get the CloudWatch Metrics updated.

workshops.title: EMR on EKS Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop shows you how to configure and run EMR on EKS and trying out various features and use cases

workshops.title: Evaluation in generative AI with Amazon Bedrock
workshops.description: This workshop teaches systematic approaches to evaluating Generative AI workloads for production use. Focused to build evaluation frameworks that go beyond basic metrics to ensure reliable model performance while optimizing cost and performance.

workshops.title: Facies Classification with Well Logs
workshops.description: In this workshop, we will utilize machine learning to classify facies from well logs data. We will use Amazon SageMaker for exploratory data analysis, training and tuning a model and deployment of the best model as an endpoint for future predictions. We will use the deployed endpoint to classify facies for a new well log data in a Jupyter notebook and visualize the results. We will use Amazon QuickSight and Amazon Q to generate business insights from well-logs.

workshops.title: Foundational Security, Identity, and Governance Workshop
workshops.description: Hands-on AWS workshop covering foundational security, identity, and governance services. Learn to implement compliance monitoring, IAM controls, data encryption, threat detection, and network security through guided exercises. Designed for IT professionals, cloud engineers, and security analysts new to AWS security.

workshops.title: Free .NET apps from Windows licensing with AI-powered portability using AWS Transform and Kiro
workshops.description: In this workshop, gain hands-on experience modernizing a .NET Framework application to cross-platform .NET. Use AWS Transform for .NET a modernization service powered by agentic AI that significantly reduces the time to migrate applications from Windows Server to Linux. Then leverage an AI-powered IDE, to identify and fix any residual gaps, giving you full confidence in your modernized application. Together, these tools create a powerful end-to-end modernization accelerators.

workshops.title: From Prototype to Production with AWS - Agentic AI Evaluation and Observability
workshops.description: This hands-on workshop guides you through building, evaluating, deploying, and continuously improving a production-ready multi-agent customer service system using AWS services.

workshops.title: GenAI/ML Standardization with SageMaker AI
workshops.description: Build a standardized ML environment on Amazon SageMaker AI covering security controls, MLOps pipelines, CI/CD automation, experiment tracking, deployment and observability.

workshops.title: GenAIOps Obervability and Evaluations with Langfuse
workshops.description: Discover how to effectively implement generative AI in your business operations using Amazon Bedrock with Langfuse on AWS. While many organizations are enthusiastic about large language models (LLMs), successful integration into daily operations requires strategic planning and proper implementation.

workshops.title: Generative AI on EKS using NVIDIA GPU
workshops.description: In this workshop, learn how to get started with Large Language Model (LLM) applications and inference on Amazon EKS. Discover how to deploy and manage production-grade LLM workloads. Through hands-on labs, you'll explore how to leverage Amazon EKS along with AWS services and open-source tools to create robust LLM solutions. The workshop environment provides all the necessary infrastructure and tools, allowing you to focus on learning and implementation.

workshops.title: Generative AI Reliability with Automated Reasoning checks in Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
workshops.description: This workshop will cover how Amazon Bedrock Guardrails incorporates Automated Reasoning checks to provide reliability and trustworthiness of GenAI applications. This workshop will demonstrate Automated Reasoning and examples that show how verification techniques integrate with Amazon Bedrock features. Attendees will have the opportunity to learn hands-on by engaging in exercises using the Automated Reasoning checks console and APIs to create and validate policies.

workshops.title: Getting started with AgentCore (Official Workshop)
workshops.description: Getting started on AgentCore: Let's build an end-to-end use case using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

workshops.title: Getting started with Amazon Connect Customer
workshops.description: In this series of labs, we’ll build cloud based contact center using AWS Amazon Connect Customer service and explore integration with other AWS services such as Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Lex and AWS Lambda to build modern and robust contact center.

workshops.title: Getting Started with Amazon WorkSpaces
workshops.description: In this lab, you'll learn how to deploy cloud desktops using Amazon WorkSpaces and the AWS Directory Service for your organizations end users.

workshops.title: Getting Started with Amazon WorkSpaces applications
workshops.description: In this lab, you will learn how to deploy and stream desktop applications using Amazon WorkSpaces applications, a fully managed, secure application and desktop streaming service that runs on AWS.

workshops.title: Getting Started with Apache Spark - A Hands-on Foundation and Spark Optimization Workshop
workshops.description: A hands-on introduction to Apache Spark, the leading distributed data processing framework. Master fundamental concepts including Spark architecture, RDDs, DataFrames, SparkSQL, and Spark Streaming through practical exercises. Ideal for ETL developers, data analysts, and BI engineers beginning their big data journey. Learn the fundamentals and develop efficient and optimized Spark applications.

workshops.title: Getting Started with AWS Outposts Servers
workshops.description: Learn how to deploy and operate AWS Outposts Servers through a hands-on workshop model. This session blends guided instruction with practical labs, giving you real experience extending AWS infrastructure and services to on-premises environments.

workshops.title: Getting Started With Multicloud on AWS
workshops.description: A hands-on level 300 workshop helping AWS customers manage and govern multicloud environments. Addresses operational challenges from M&A, leveraging differentiated CSP capabilities, or managing portfolio companies. Covers centralized operations, observability, security, compliance, authorization, and networking across multiple Cloud Service Providers using AWS services.

workshops.title: Getting started with Quick Automate
workshops.description: In this getting started workshop with quick automate you will build an intelligent retail website compliance workflow. In this hands-on workshop, you'll automate the entire content review pipeline from web content extraction and analysis to violation detection and case management. Create a workflow that screens content for objectionable material, categorizes violations by severity, and streamlines human review.

workshops.title: Getting Started with Trusted Advisor on AWS
workshops.description: Intro module and accompanying lab. Show the customer the value proposition and how they can leverage TA to follow AWS best practices. AWS Trusted Advisor identifies ways to improve your AWS infrastructure across 5 unique pillars: Security, Performance, Cost Optimization, Fault Tolerance, and AWS Service Quotas.

workshops.title: Getting started with Visual Asset Management System (VAMS)
workshops.description: This is an introductory workshop on getting started with Visual Asset Management System(VAMS). This workshop will introduce the fundamental building blocks of VAMS. By the end of this workshop users would have learned to deploy VAMS, uploading assets to VAMS, create VAMS Pipelines and Workflows and deleting VAMS from their AWS Accounts

workshops.title: Hands-on experience with Amazon CloudWatch
workshops.description: A hands-on Level 300 workshop (~3hrs) covering AWS observability with CloudWatch and X-Ray across 5 labs: infrastructure monitoring, serverless instrumentation, user experience (RUM & Synthetics), container insights (ECS/EKS), and database insights — building practical skills to monitor and optimize AWS workloads.

workshops.title: Hands-on multi-tenant agents: Inside tenant-aware agentic systems
workshops.description: scalable AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Learn to orchestrate multi-agent workflows across tenants, integrate knowledge bases, logs, and custom agents, and apply best practices in governance, monitoring, and cost optimization. Walk away with blueprints and strategies to build secure, efficient, multi-tenant AI systems at scale.

workshops.title: How to run an AWS Well-Architected Framework Review
workshops.description: There are three phases to running a successful and efficient Well-Architected Framework Review (WAFR): Prepare, Review, Improve. This workshop will step through the three phases ensuring you have sufficient preparation in place to get the most value from the review phase, and will guide you into turning the findings into actionable improvements for the workload.

workshops.title: HPC for Power Grid Simulation
workshops.description: Learn how to run grid modeling and large-scale simulations through commercial power system software on an HPC cluster consisting of Windows compute nodes on AWS. This workshop will show how to accelerate power system engineering studies such as generation interconnection and distribution planning analysis in a cost-effective manner.

workshops.title: IAM Core Workshop (Formerly: IAM Immersion Day)
workshops.description: The IAM workshop provides a comprehensive introduction through advanced concepts with AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM). The basic modules help learners get started with some basic concepts, such as users, roles, and policies. The advanced modules provide a much deeper dive into policies, role switching, ABAC, monitoring, and advanced permissions concepts.

workshops.title: IAM Identity Center: Empowering Secure Access to Generative AI Applications
workshops.description: Join this workshop to get a better understanding of how to provide your developers access to generative AI applications, including Amazon Q. We will teach you how to connect your corporate identities to AWS, and how to use your corporate login to manage access to generative AI applications. We will guide you through managing session duration and security to simplify your users’ experience.

workshops.title: IND 338 - Automate Analysis and Extract Intelligence from Financial Datasets
workshops.description: Join this workshop to build a unified platform for data, analytics, and generative AI using Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio. You'll architect a modern data lake that enables collaboration between data producers and consumers, implement multi-engine analytics with AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, and Amazon EMR Serverless, and create interactive visualizations with Amazon Quick Suite. Unlock the power of AI by deploying intelligent chatbots with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that automate financial analysis.

workshops.title: IND3328-R - Natural Language to Telco Infrastructure deployment with Amazon Kiro CLI & MCP
workshops.description: In this hands-on session, learn how Agentic-AI and Model-Context Protocol transform Telco network deployments. AI agents convert network specifications into infrastructure-as-code for automated deployment. Built on Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Kiro CLI, EKS, and CloudWatch, the system allows operators to use natural language for generating production-ready infrastructure code. This solution reduces errors, speeds up deployments, and maintains compliance across Core, IMS, and O-RAN applications.

workshops.title: Integrating IAM Access Analyzer into a CI/CD Pipeline
workshops.description: Want to analyze IAM policies at scale? Want your developers to write secure IAM policies? In this hands-on workshop, you are given the opportunity to build a CI/CD pipeline that validates IAM policies using IAM Access Analyzer and the IAM Policy Validator for AWS CloudFormation.

workshops.title: Introduction to AWS Backup
workshops.description: Introduction to AWS Backup This workshop includes 6 labs that are designed to provide you an end-to-end hands-on experience to the AWS Backup fundamental concepts required to design and implement a secure and efficient data protection solution on AWS using AWS Backup. Each lab is independent of the others, and none of them are prerequisites for any of the others.

workshops.title: Java on AWS
workshops.description: Explore modern Java on AWS containers: deploy to Amazon EKS Auto Mode and ECS Express Mode for simplified operations. Achieve faster startup times using Java 25 AOT cache, CRaC checkpoint/restore, and Class Data Sharing. Build optimized images with Jib and lazy-load with SOCI. Run on AWS Graviton for up to 40% better price-performance. Leverage Amazon Bedrock to automatically analyze JVM thread dumps and async-profiler flamegraphs, generating AI-powered optimization insights.

workshops.title: Java on AWS Lambda
workshops.description: Learning objectives: In this workshop you will learn how to build cloud-native Java applications, best practices and performance optimizations techniques and how to migrate your existing Java application to AWS Lambda.

workshops.title: Karpenter Workshop
workshops.description: Explore using Karpenter with Amazon EKS to express workload requirements, and observe Karpenter automatically provisioning and consolidating EC2 instances. Through a series of hands-on labs, participants will explore advanced topics including instance type selection, spot interruption handling, bin-packing and consolidation policies, and cost optimization strategies.

workshops.title: Kinesis Data Streams Workshop
workshops.description: The Kinesis Data Streams workshop will guide you through interacting with your Kinesis Data Streams in many different ways--Create a Kinesis Data Stream, write to it in various ways and read from it in various ways as well to fulfill virtually any real-time streaming needs for your business.

workshops.title: Kiro Core
workshops.description: Turn plain English into specs, working code, and tests — reviewing every step. Build a real app hands-on with Kiro, Amazon's AI-native dev agent, on your surface of choice: IDE, CLI, or IntelliJ. Go from chat-driven edits to full spec-driven development, then steer the agent with skills, MCP, custom agents, and hooks. No backend to deploy — it runs in your browser. ~4 hours, modules stand alone. For developers, from first-timers to automation power users.

workshops.title: Kiro Crew: The Autonomous Developer Workflow
workshops.description: Kiro Crew is an open-source AI agent workspace that runs on your own hardware and keeps working between conversations. In this hands-on workshop you'll learn its workflow engine, define and teach your own agents, and compose a team of specialized agents. You'll give them persistent knowledge and memory, then schedule jobs that run overnight and brief you before your day starts. You leave with a working Kiro Crew setup you'll actually use for daily development.

workshops.title: Kiro Express
workshops.description: Discover Kiro, your IDE build from the ground-up to seamlessly integrate AI agents into the development workflow. Explore how to use Kiro as your intelligent partner - helping to understand complex codebases, crystalize detailed requirements, and deliver quality solutions at unprecedented speed. You will iterate with Kiro to finalize your detailed design, before using Kiro to orchestrate AI agents and implement a fully working solution

workshops.title: Launching EC2 Spot Instances
workshops.description: In this workshop you learn about the fundamentals of EC2 Spot Instances and recommended tools to launch Spot Instances, test for resiliency, and view pricing history.

workshops.title: Lift-and-Shift Migration of Microsoft Workloads using AWS Transform MGN
workshops.description: The Microsoft Workloads Migration guides customers through the process of Lift-and-shift migrating their Microsoft workloads to AWS.

workshops.title: MAM406 - Migrate & Modernize Windows to Linux and SQL to PostgreSQL with agentic AI
workshops.description: Join this Activation Day to migrate and modernize Microsoft Server workloads to Amazon EC2 using AWS Application Migration Service and AWS Transform. This hands-on session leverages Kiro to accelerate planning and execution, covering best practices for rehosting, right-sizing, and optimizing licensing costs. Ideal for IT teams looking to reduce on-premises footprint and unlock cloud benefits.

workshops.title: Manage, monitor and operate Microsoft workload securely on AWS
workshops.description: In this hands-on workshop, discover how to efficiently manage and secure Microsoft Windows fleets on AWS through key services like EC2 Image Builder, AWS Systems Manager, and CloudWatch. Learn to build and deploy secure Windows images, automate patching, configure settings, and implement monitoring solutions. Explore best practices with Amazon Inspector and AWS Config to enhance security while reducing operational overhead.

workshops.title: Migrate with AWS Application Migration Service (MGN)
workshops.description: In this workshop you will learn how to configure and use MGN. This is 300-level 2-hours workshop covering in depth how to set up MGN service from scratch, configure default templates (Replication, Launch, Post-Launch), update servers EC2 LTs, and complete the migration. Unlike the "Migration Journey with MGN" workshop, this one does NOT focus on post-launch actions like DRS and custom SSM document creation, it's focused on understanding MGN initial concepts and service configuration options.

workshops.title: Migration and Modernization - Rehost and Tagging - Lab 1
workshops.description: This workshop is focused on Rehosting and Tagging activities. It enables participants to perform a complete migration to AWS supported by AWS Application Migration Service. It also offers a tagging playground using different automation methods. This workshop is part of a series, check the “Migration and Modernization Pathways – Lab2” and “Migration and Modernization Pathways – Lab3” for learning about the different modernization pathways.

workshops.title: Migration and Modernization Pathways - Lab 3
workshops.description: The Migration and Modernization Pathways – Lab 3 is designed for technical audiences exploring the different pathways, including: Move to Managed Databases, Move to Modern Analytics, and Move to Open Source. This workshop is part of a series, check the "Migration and Modernization Pathways – Lab 2" for other pathways and the "Migration and Modernization - Rehost and Tagging - Lab 1" for Application Migration Service and tagging.

workshops.title: Migration and Modernization Pathways – Lab 2
workshops.description: The Migration and Modernization Pathways – Lab Day 2 is designed for technical audiences exploring the different pathways, including: Move to Modern DevOps, Move to AI, and Move to Containers. This workshop is part of a series, check the “Migration and Modernization Pathways – Lab 3” for other pathways and the "Migration and Modernization - Rehost and Tagging - Lab 1" for Application Migration Service and tagging.

workshops.title: ModelOps on Amazon SageMaker AI MLFlow App
workshops.description: Specialized technical workshop is designed for ML administrators and engineers seeking hands-on skills in managing and utilizing Amazon SageMakerAI MLflow App. The course delves into essential topics such as administrating SageMaker AI MLFlow Appand example workloads. Participants will also gain deep insights into MLflow constructs like experiments, models, prompts, SageMaker-MLflow integration, and tracing. Advanced segments will cover workloads like genai agents, and agent deployment.

workshops.title: Modernizing FinCrime Detection with AI
workshops.description: Transform financial crime detection using Amazon Bedrock AI agents to automate AML compliance and suspicious activity reporting

workshops.title: Multi-Agent Backtesting for Quant Developers by Bedrock AgentCore and Strands Agent SDK
workshops.description: This workshop deploys multiple specialized agents, developed by Strands Agent SDK, deployed to Bedrock AgentCore, to transform trading ideas into backtested strategies from days to minutes: 1, Strategy Generator Agent - on Agentcore Runtime 2, Market Data Tool - Fetches market data on Agentcore Gateway 3, Backtest Tool - Backtests in Code Interpreter 4, Results Summary Agent - on Agentcore Runtime 5, Quant Agent to orchestrate the tools and agents above using Strands Agent SDK

workshops.title: Next-gen agentic SaaS: Transforming to an agent-powered experience
workshops.description: The move to Agentic AI is having a profound impact on SaaS providers. For many, this will have a transformative effect on their business and architecture. This workshop will take an end-to-end pass through an agentic modernization, extracting functionality from an application and moving it into intelligent agents.

workshops.title: Nova customization on AWS
workshops.description: This workshop provides hands-on experience customizing Amazon Nova models on AWS. Attendees will learn to fine-tune Nova using Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker Training Jobs with the Nova Customization SDK, and SageMaker HyperPod with EKS — covering SFT, DPO, and RL with LoRA, deploying custom models, and evaluating them using LLM-as-a Judge.

workshops.title: Once Upon Agentic AI: A Developer's Epic Journey
workshops.description: Welcome, brave adventurer, to the ultimate Strands framework quest! This comprehensive workshop will transform you from a coding apprentice into a master of AI agent orchestration. Through five epic chapters, you'll learn to create, equip, and command digital companions that can think, act, and collaborate like a legendary adventuring party.

workshops.title: One Media Workshop
workshops.description: One Media Workshop provides a prescriptive, 100-400 level modular learning experience focusing on AWS Media Services, solutions for popular workloads, and advanced modules covering complex use cases.

workshops.title: One Observability Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop is aimed at providing an hands-on experience for you on the wide variety of toolsets AWS offers to setup monitoring and observability on your applications.

workshops.title: Platform Engineering on EKS
workshops.description: We build production-ready IDP platforms on Amazon EKS, combining CNCF tools with AWS services. Explore hands-on experience with Amazon Q Developer, managed databases, Backstage, ArgoCD, Crossplane, and OAM. Learn to accelerate platform adoption using GenAI-powered tools and automated delivery pipelines. Built on EKS Blueprints and CNOE, our solution enables modern cloud-native development on AWS. There is also a 2hour version :Accelerate platform engineering on Amazon EKS (CON401)

workshops.title: PostgreSQL Fundamentals for Developers
workshops.description: This workshops helps developer to gain essential skillset of Aurora PostgreSQL to develop their application. This module covers following topics: Connect to your PostgreSQL Database Secure your Database Create your schema objects Advanced developer capabilities Backup your database Monitor database performance using Performance Insights Optimize your queries

workshops.title: Prebid Server Workshop
workshops.description: Prebid Server Workshop

workshops.title: Real-Time Streaming with Amazon MSK
workshops.description: Master real-time data streaming with Amazon MSK through hands-on labs. Learn to provision and scale MSK clusters, implement monitoring with CloudWatch and Prometheus, configure security and encryption, integrate with AWS Lambda and Apache Flink, and migrate from self-managed Kafka. Build production-ready streaming pipelines using MSK Express Brokers for enhanced performance. Ideal for data engineers building real-time applications.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)

workshops.title: Reduce EKS cluster compute costs with EC2 Flex instances
workshops.description: EC2 flex instances are a more cost-efficient choice for workloads that don't keep their CPUs busy all the time. In this workshop, you move SnapShelf, an object detection service on Amazon EKS Auto Mode, from 8th generation Intel EC2 instances to flex instances with a single NodePool change. You compare latency, throughput and cost before and after, and learn which node metrics to watch when you run flex instances in production

workshops.title: Refining IAM Permissions Like A Pro
workshops.description: We will learn how to use AWS services to detect unused IAM permissions, and ways to use them to safely move to a clean least privilege environment. You will learn about relevant features of Last Accessed Information and Access Analyzer and use automation to continuously analyze unused IAM permissions. And finally, you will learn about different options of removing unused permissions and how to customize them towards your own process and workflow.

workshops.title: Research Computing Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop provides hands-on experience in cloud computing basics, containers, High Performance Computing (HPC), and AI/Machine Learning for researchers and research IT staff with little to no cloud computing background.

workshops.title: Running Efficient Kubernetes Clusters on Amazon EC2 with EKS, Karpenter, EC2 Spot, and Graviton
workshops.description: Learn how to provision, manage, and maintain your efficient Kubernetes clusters with Amazon EKS at any scale using EC2 Spot, Graviton, and Karpenter using EKS Auto Mode. Karpenter is a node lifecycle management solution used to scale your EKS Cluster. It observes incoming pods and launches the right instances for the situation. Instance selection decisions are intent based and driven by the specification of incoming pods, including resource requests and scheduling constraints.

workshops.title: SageMaker HyperPod EKS for AWS Hosted Events
workshops.description: SageMaker HyperPod removes the undifferentiated heavy lifting involved in building and optimizing machine learning (ML) infrastructure for training foundation models (FMs), reducing training time by up to 40%. In this builders’ session, learn how to pre-train a large language model (LLM) using Slurm on SageMaker HyperPod. Explore the model pre-training workflow from start to finish, including setting up clusters, troubleshooting convergence issues, and running distributed training.

workshops.title: SageMaker HyperPod Slurm for AWS Hosted Events
workshops.description: SageMaker HyperPod removes the undifferentiated heavy lifting involved in building and optimizing machine learning (ML) infrastructure for training foundation models (FMs), reducing training time by up to 40%. In this builders’ session, learn how to pre-train a large language model (LLM) using Slurm on SageMaker HyperPod. Explore the model pre-training workflow from start to finish, including setting up clusters, troubleshooting convergence issues, and running distributed training.

workshops.title: Salesforce Contact Center with Amazon Connect - Generative AI Concepts, Features and Architecture
workshops.description: This is part of Salesforce Contact Center with Amazon Connect (SCC-AC) workshop series, this module covers Generative AI concepts, features and high level architecture from Amazon Connect perspective.

workshops.title: Securing AWS Network Traffic: Network Firewall & DNS Firewall Workshop
workshops.description: A comprehensive workshop demonstrating how to secure AWS network traffic using AWS Network Firewall and Route 53 DNS Firewall. Learn to implement and manage network security controls for VPC and Transit Gateway architectures to protect your cloud workloads.

workshops.title: Securing your network perimeter through observability
workshops.description: Enhance your AWS security posture by monitoring VPC activity using AWS CloudTrail and Amazon CloudWatch. Build a comprehensive security monitoring solution for your VPC perimeter. Learn to capture and analyze VPC activity, then create powerful dashboards, metrics, and alerts for deep visibility into activity patterns.

workshops.title: Serverless Data Lake Day
workshops.description: This Serverless Data Lake Day workshop is prepared to assist customers build a cloud-native and future-proof serverless data lake architecture using Amazon Kinesis Firehose for streaming data ingestion, AWS Glue for data integration (ETL & Catalogue Management), S3 for data lake storage, and Amazon Athena to SQL big data analytics. Serverless Data Lake Day helps customers create a modern data platform on AWS, which is ready process huge amounts of data.

workshops.title: Serverless Model Customization with Amazon SageMaker AI
workshops.description: This workshop provides hands-on experience with serverless model customization on Amazon SageMaker AI. Attendees will learn to prepare datasets, run serverless fine-tuning with LoRA across SFT, DPO, RLVR, and RLAIF, deploy fine-tuned models, and evaluate them using LLM-as-a-Judge.

workshops.title: Serverless Observability Workshop
workshops.description: The Serverless Observability Workshop is also designed to help customers familiar with observability in traditional architectures better understand how to succeed with Serverless. Customers gain an awareness of AWS managed services, such as AWS Lambda and Amazon API Gateway, as well as AWS X-Ray and Amazon CloudWatch for monitoring their new and existing applications end-to-end.

workshops.title: Serverless Patterns
workshops.description: In this workshop, you will learn serverless best practices by building production-ready code for an application.

workshops.title: Serverless Security Workshop
workshops.description: In this workshop, you will learn techniques to secure a serverless application built with AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway and RDS Aurora.

workshops.title: Serverlesspresso
workshops.description: In this workshop, you will deploy a serverless backend that supports a pop-up coffee shop. You will then test your application using 3 front-end applications that are provided.

workshops.title: Serverlesspresso: The Lambda Durable Functions edition
workshops.description: In this workshop, discover how to build a complete coffee-ordering serverless web application. Learn about event-driven architectures and how to use services such as AWS Lambda, Amazon EventBridge, AWS Lambda Durable Functions, and more. Create a scalable, serverless web application that allows users to order coffee and baristas to keep track of and fulfill orders.

workshops.title: SQL Server on AWS Workshop
workshops.description: Learn how to migrate your SQL workloads to AWS, running on EC2 or managed environments. You will also learn about best practices for storage solutions for your SQL workloads on AWS, and modernizing your SQL server toward Amazon Aurora.

workshops.title: Storytelling based AI-powered insights and automation using Amazon Quick
workshops.description: In this workshop, participants will learn Amazon Quick's powerful AI capabilities through a storytelling approach. Participants will learn how to derive insights from data based on real business scenarios and automate repetitive tasks.

workshops.title: The Amazon API Gateway Workshop
workshops.description: The workshop covers the primary features of Amazon API Gateway.

workshops.title: The AWS Step Functions Workshop
workshops.description: The workshop covers the primary features of AWS Step Functions. It contains all the latest changes including JSONata.

workshops.title: The Migration Journey with AWS Transform (MGN)
workshops.description: In this workshop, you will use learn how to use MGN throughout the migration journey. You will start by using discovery data to create your inventory in the MGN console, then you will group your servers into applications and waves, and finish by testing and orchestrating the cutover. Unlike "Migrate with MGN" workshop, this one is skipping the MGN configuration steps and is focused on further modernization steps using existing (DRS) or custom (create your own) post-launch actions.

workshops.title: Threat Detection and Response Workshop
workshops.description: This workshop is designed to get you familiar with the AWS threat detection and response services, best practices, use cases, and then use what you learn to dive deeper into scenarios. All of this is designed to prepare you and help you operate more securely on AWS. This workshop goes though overviews and operationalization of Amazon GuardDuty and Amazon Detective.

workshops.title: Timestream Data Lab Day
workshops.description: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB is a managed time-series database engine that makes it easy to run InfluxDB databases on AWS for time-series applications using open-source APIs. Labs covers on how to ingest, query and visualize data for both versions of InfluxDB, V3.x and previous version of V2.7.

workshops.title: Track and Optimize Generative AI Spend on AWS
workshops.description: Learn to track and optimize generative AI spend on Amazon Bedrock using multiple cost attribution methods: IAM principal attribution, inference profiles, projects, per-request metadata tagging, and IAM identity log attribution. Apply these across multi-tenant apps, Claude Code, and AgentCore agents. Explore LiteLLM for multi-provider tracking. Build dashboards with Cost Explorer, CUR 2.0, and CUDOS.

workshops.title: Unlocking the power of Carbon Emissions & CUR
workshops.description: In this hands-on session, attendees will dive deep into the power of Carbon emissions & Cost and Usage Reports and related data sources. We'll explore how to query the data in a simple and efficient manner, empowering you to gain valuable insights into your cloud resource consumption. We'll introduce the Cloud Intelligence dashboards and ways to customize it. You'll learn how to visualize this data in various formats.

workshops.title: Verified Permissions in action
workshops.description: A workshop to teach users how to write policies, call Amazon Verified Permissions APIs, and create a working application on Amazon Verified Permissions.

workshops.title: Video Understanding with Generative AI on AWS
workshops.description: Unlock the power of generative and agentic AI to transform video understanding on AWS. This hands-on workshop teaches developers to extract deep context from video using Amazon Bedrock Data Automation, Amazon Nova models, Bedrock AgentCore, and AWS AI services like Rekognition and Transcribe. Participants build scalable pipelines for media operations and live video scenarios, improving searchability, personalization, and ad placement through time-based and multi-modal metadata analysis.

workshops.title: Windows Containers on AWS
workshops.description: In this workshop, you will learn how to deploy and manage an Amazon EKS cluster for Windows containers, handling different Windows versions in the same cluster, setting up gMSA for Kerberos authentication on Windows containers, and persistent storage through EBS volumes.
